Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer expected has not appeared in their account.
activate_my_card: How to activate a newly received card.
age_limit: Minimum age or age-related eligibility to open or use an account.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Adding the card to Apple Pay / Google Pay, or problems using them.
atm_support: Which ATMs or cash machines the card can be used at.
automatic_top_up: Setting up or how automatic (auto) top-ups work.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A bank transfer into the account has not yet shown up in the balance.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit has not yet shown up in the balance.
beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer failed because the recipient/beneficiary could not be added or is not allowed.
cancel_transfer: Cancelling or reversing a transfer that was already sent.
card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring soon; how to get a replacement.
card_acceptance: Where (which merchants/places) the card is accepted.
card_arrival: A card was ordered and has not arrived yet.
card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery usually takes.
card_linking: Linking an existing card to the app or account.
card_not_working: The card does not work in general (not a specific declined payment).
card_payment_fee_charged: An unexpected fee was charged on a card payment.
card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment the customer does not recognise.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card payment in foreign currency used a wrong-looking exchange rate.
cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee was charged for a cash withdrawal.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal the customer did not make.
change_pin: How or where to change the card PIN.
compromised_card: The card details may have been stolen or misused.
country_support: Which countries the service or card is available in.
declined_card_payment: A card payment at a merchant was declined.
declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise.
disposable_card_limits: Limits on how often/how much disposable virtual cards can be used.
edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details.
exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used / where to see it.
extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge appears on the statement.
fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies can be held or exchanged.
get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
get_physical_card: How to get a physical card (e.g. after having a virtual one).
getting_spare_card: Ordering an additional or spare card.
getting_virtual_card: How to get a virtual card.
lost_or_stolen_card: The card was lost or stolen.
lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone with the app was lost or stolen.
order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card and related costs/steps.
passcode_forgotten: The customer forgot the app passcode.
pending_card_payment: A card payment is still showing as pending.
pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still showing as pending.
pending_transfer: A transfer the customer sent is still pending.
pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked after wrong attempts.
receiving_money: How to receive money into the account.
request_refund: Asking for a refund of a purchase.
reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/reversed and the customer asks why.
supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards and currencies are supported for top-ups or payments.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up via bank transfer.
top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque.
top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts or frequency.
top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or cancelled.
topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card, or problems doing so.
transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice.
transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer.
transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The customer sent a transfer, but the recipient reports it has not arrived.
unable_to_verify_identity: The customer is having trouble completing identity verification.
verify_my_identity: How to verify identity / what documents are needed.
verify_source_of_funds: Questions about proving the source of funds.
verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up (e.g. a verification code or amount).
virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working.
visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: An ATM gave a different amount of cash than requested.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A foreign cash withdrawal used a wrong-looking exchange rate.
